content: {"reasoning":"The CO-197 denial reflects missing required authorization; this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review, and no claim-data error is identified. A formal medical-necessity appeal remains available and is the only action that produced payment in similar claims (2/14), despite weak documentation and a low success rate. The payer path is not exhausted, so writing off or shifting the denied balance to the patient is premature.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
